action_catalog.title: Contain and remediate an active critical security alert
execution_steps: Review the active critical alert evidence and affected resource scope
Confirm the business-mapped owner and support team for the affected resource
Assess containment scope in the governed non-production environment where feasible
Present the containment and remediation approach with alert evidence for approval
Validate the alert clears and resource health remains stable after authorized action
preconditions: The critical alert evidence is current and attributable to a known resource
The resource owner and support team are identified
A verified recovery point exists for the affected resource
rollback_actions: Halt the authorized containment step
Restore the verified pre-action recovery point
Validate resource health and dependent service transactions
success_criteria: The active critical alert clears in Defender
No new critical alert appears for the same resource within the validation window
failure_criteria: The alert remains active after the authorized action
A new critical alert appears on the same resource

metadata.phase_3_allowlist_rationale: Alert containment can involve resource state changes and needs case-by-case scoping before any allowlisting.

action_catalog.title: Break an evidenced attack path through governed segmentation review
execution_steps: Review the attack path graph and identify the node role this resource plays
Assess governed network and identity segmentation options that break the path
Validate the proposed segmentation change against dependent service traffic in Test
Present the segmentation change and attack path evidence for approval
Validate the attack path no longer includes this resource after authorized execution
preconditions: The attack path evidence is current
Dependent service traffic patterns are understood
A rollback network or identity configuration is captured
rollback_actions: Halt the authorized segmentation change
Restore the prior network or identity configuration
Validate dependent service connectivity and health
success_criteria: The resource is no longer a member of the evidenced attack path
No new attack path membership appears within the validation window
failure_criteria: The resource remains part of an attack path
A new attack path membership appears

metadata.phase_3_allowlist_rationale: Segmentation changes affect connectivity and require human judgment on blast radius.

action_catalog.title: Remediate an unhealthy secure-score control
execution_steps: Review the unhealthy secure-score control recommendation and affected resource
Validate the governed remediation baseline for the control in Test
Document the approved configuration or policy delta
Present the staged control remediation for approval
Validate the control reports healthy after authorized execution
preconditions: The unhealthy control recommendation is current
A governed remediation baseline exists for the control
A last known-good configuration is retained
rollback_actions: Halt the staged control remediation
Restore the last known-good configuration
Validate secure-score control state and service health
success_criteria: The secure-score gap for this resource narrows
failure_criteria: The secure-score gap does not narrow

metadata.phase_3_allowlist_rationale: Well-scoped configuration control remediations are a reasonable low-risk Phase 3 starting subset per D-29.

action_catalog.title: Remediate an exploitable vulnerability finding
execution_steps: Review the exploitable finding evidence and known-exploited status
Validate the approved remediation or update baseline in the governed non-production ring
Present the remediation evidence and maintenance window for approval
Stage the approved remediation for authorized execution
Validate the finding clears and service health remains stable
preconditions: An approved remediation or update baseline exists for the finding
A recent recoverable backup or snapshot is verified
Application and service owners acknowledge the maintenance window
rollback_actions: Stop the authorized remediation rollout
Restore the verified pre-change recovery point
Reapply the last known-good baseline
Validate service health and dependent transactions
success_criteria: The exploitable finding no longer appears for this resource
No new exploitable finding appears within the validation window
failure_criteria: The finding remains exploitable after remediation

metadata.phase_3_allowlist_rationale: Exploitable finding remediation frequently requires a maintenance window and owner acknowledgement, so it should stay human-approved in Phase 3.

action_catalog.title: Controlled patch and failed-update recovery
execution_steps: Validate the approved update baseline and maintenance constraints
Test the update package in the governed non-production ring
Present test evidence and maintenance window for approval
Stage the approved platform change for authorized execution
Validate service health, compliance, and dependent transactions
preconditions: Recent recoverable backup or snapshot is verified
Application and service owners acknowledge the maintenance window
rollback_actions: Stop the authorized rollout at the current ring
Restore the verified pre-change recovery point using the approved platform
Reapply the last known-good update baseline
Validate service transactions and dependency health
success_criteria: Application health and dependent transaction checks pass

metadata.phase_3_allowlist_rationale: Test-ring validated patch recovery on non-critical resources is a reasonable low-risk Phase 3 starting subset per D-29.

action_catalog.title: Recover the governed configuration baseline
execution_steps: Review expected and observed configuration evidence
Validate the governed baseline in Test
Document approved configuration deltas
Present the staged baseline recovery for approval
Validate policy and service health after authorized execution
preconditions: Expected configuration is governed and current
A last known-good configuration is retained
rollback_actions: Stop staged recovery
Restore the last known-good configuration
Validate policy state and service transactions

metadata.phase_3_allowlist_rationale: Baseline configuration recovery validated in Test is a reasonable low-risk Phase 3 starting subset per D-29.
